meta.title: About Iorta TechNXT | Insurance Technology & Modernization
meta.description: Learn how Iorta TechNXT builds insurance products and modernization capabilities across distribution, servicing, claims and enterprise technology.

hero.title: Technology built for the business insurance is becoming.
hero.lede: Iorta TechNXT combines focused insurance products with modernization engineering to improve distribution, underwriting, servicing, claims and the technology foundations behind them.

roles.description: Bring channels, systems and partners together.
Turn complex journeys into clearer digital experiences.
Support changing markets, channels and operating models.

sections.title: We work where insurance operations meet technology.
body: Our work sits at the intersection of insurance operations and technology: sales, intermediary distribution, onboarding, customer service, underwriting, claims, core integration, data and application modernization.

sections.title: One operating model does not fit every market.
body: Insurance markets differ in distribution, regulation, languages, Takaful requirements, core platforms and digital maturity.
We design for that reality instead of assuming one operating model fits every market.

roles.description: Understand what customers and employees are trying to achieve.
Hide avoidable operational and technology complexity from the user.
Products, channels, regulation and expectations will continue to evolve.
Technology must work with the reality of enterprise insurance.
Technology matters when it changes a customer, operational or business outcome.

sections.title: Company figures are published from one verified source.
body: Corporate numbers, office locations, customer counts, market presence and awards are deliberately not stated on this page yet. They will be published only when current and verified, and maintained from a single source of truth so they stay consistent across the site.
Publishing an approximate headcount or client count here and a different one elsewhere is the fastest way to lose a reader's trust.

sections.title: Individual profiles are pending approval.
body: Named biographies, photographs and LinkedIn links are published only with each person's approval. They are not listed here yet.

Each profile will follow one structure: name, current role, an 80 to 120 word biography covering insurance and technology experience, current responsibility and areas of expertise, and a LinkedIn link where approved.

sections.title: Different expertise. One focus: moving insurance forward.
body: Build technology around real industry problems. Keep customer outcomes visible. Create clear accountability. Invest in people and delivery discipline. Learn across markets.

sections.title: Live vacancies are not listed here yet.
body: Open roles will be published from the recruitment system rather than maintained by hand, so that a role never appears here after it has been filled.

Each listing will carry the role, location, department, work model and a short summary. Each role detail page will carry the role purpose, responsibilities, required and preferred experience, location and work model, the hiring process and an application route.

sections.title: Good people do not always arrive when a job title does.
body: If nothing listed fits but you think you should be here, get in touch through the approved recruitment channel rather than waiting for a vacancy.
